Ecclus 3:22; J Aram. רְשָׁא have power, Aph. permit; Old Aramaic רשי cause, occasion, Lzb370, Nab. allowed, Id.ib.; Syriac ܪܫܳܐ is usually blame; Assyrian rašû, possess, râšû, creditor; Arabic (و) رَسَا be firm, iv. make firm; Ethiopic ረሰየ: set, put in, place over, prepare, etc.; Sab. רשו servant of deity JHMordtmZMG xxx (1876), 31 f.).
